Patrick (Cruach Phadraig, "Patrick's Heap"), a mountain in County Mayo, is a
center for Christian pilgrimage, associated with the life of St. Patrick.
 28g: Tom the Lunatic is apparently a fictitious character. Yeats draws on
"Tom o' Bedlam," a term applied to inmates of Bedlam Hospital, a London
insane asylum, who were released periodically to beg for money to pay their
keep.
